description: Wall of the Oath (맹세의 성벽): a tall tower shield standing upright with thin lines of soft blue-gold light running along its rim, a faint wall of light rising behind it.
Blockade (퇴로 봉쇄): three arrows with red fletching stuck crosswise in the ground in front of a small plain stake barrier, a hawk feather caught on one.
Dawn Prayer (새벽의 기도): a pair of hands raised around a small rising sun of soft dawn-pink and pale gold light, a few motes of light rising.
Badge of the Oath (맹세의 휘장): a small round badge of pale grey stone set in a plain worn silver rim, a faint blue-gold glint in its center.
Leaf of the Ward Tree (고목의 잎): a single broad green leaf from the ancient ward tree, its veins glowing faintly gold, a drop of dew on it.
Basic Potion (기본 회복약): a small round glass flask of clear amber-gold healing draught with a cork stopper and a twist of twine at the neck (the basic potion).
